purpose: Persist machine-verifiable application schema compatibility evidence for applied migrations.
lockImpact: Takes a short ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on the small technical migration registry while adding nullable columns and constraints.
dataImpact: Backfills compatibility evidence only for applied versions 0000000001 through 0000000010 whose persisted SQL checksums exactly match the reviewed values.
backfill: A bounded, idempotency-by-transaction UPDATE covers at most ten technical registry rows; checksum mismatch aborts and rolls back the migration.
recovery: Before application, restore the reviewed database recovery point if required. After application, retain the additive columns when rolling back application code; do not drop evidence while newer applications depend on it.
forwardFix: Append a later reviewed migration to repair constraints or evidence. Never rewrite this migration after it has run.
